Suggested use: Mix one (1) or two (2) scoops into your favorite beverage or water once daily as a dietary supplement.

1 scoop= 11g collagen
2 scoops= 22g collagen

Notes & tips:
This product mixes best in warm water or room temperature water and may clump in cold water. If you desire to drink it cold, mix in room temperature water first and then add ice.

If this container doesn't appear completely full, this is normal as the product is packaged by weight and not by volume. Some space is intentionally left in the container and settling can occur over time.
These collagen peptides come from the highest quality (grass-fed) sources so variations in color, aroma, and solubility can occur.
To maintain best product consistency, ensure that the lid is tightly closed.
Caution: Do not exceed recommended daily intake.
